newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Restaurants Corp says IPO to raise $20 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Restaurants Corp says IPO to raise $20 mln.

text.p: The Mexican Restaurant Corporation said on Wednesday it expected to raise $20 million in an initial public offering on the Mexican stock exchange over the next few days.
Between May 30 and June 2, the company will offer investors up to 68,979,717 million shares at a price ranging between 2.20 and 2.50 pesos per share.

The proceeds of the deal, equivalent to 28 percent of the company's capital, will be used to finance plans for expansion, which include the opening of 20 cafeterias and four specialized restaurants, a company document obtained by Reuters said.
Analysts say this is an attractive offer, since the company has about 10 percent of the restaurant market share and its profits have shown sustained growth over the past few years.

"In our view this issue presents solid growth prospects...for which we recommend participation in this offering which will yield good returns in the short term," said one sector analyst who declined to be named.
